record_type.description: Type of dataset record, where post rows always have the value post.

source_platform.description: Platform the record was collected from, normally facebook.

provider.description: Normalized identifier of the data provider or extraction backend that produced the row.

rank.description: One-based position of this post in the result order for its profile run, where 1 is the first post returned.

source_profile_id.description: Resolved numeric Facebook ID of the target profile as a string, or null when it could not be resolved.

source_profile_url.description: Public Facebook URL of the profile whose posts were collected.

source_profile_name.description: Public display name of the target Facebook profile, or null when not exposed.

source_profile_type.description: Resolved classification of the profile target being scraped, or null when it could not be determined.

source_post_id.description: Stable Facebook identifier of the post as a string, or null when Facebook did not expose one.

source_url.description: Public Facebook URL of the individual post, or null when no permalink was exposed.

created_at.description: Facebook publication time of the post as an ISO 8601 timestamp, not the scrape time, or null when unavailable.

created_at_source.description: Provenance of the publication timestamp, normally graphql_creation_time, or null when no timestamp was found.

created_at_precision.description: Classification of how precise the publication timestamp is, or null when no timestamp was found.

creation_time.description: Raw Facebook publication time as a Unix timestamp in seconds, or null when unavailable.

raw_text.description: Best recovered body text of the post, taken from the direct message or a nested message, and an empty string when no text was found.

text_source.description: Where the body text was extracted from, such as direct_message for the post's own message or fallback_nested_message for text recovered from a nested or shared message.

text_missing_reason.description: Diagnostic reason explaining why no body text was exposed, or null when text was recovered.

text_candidates.description: Ranked list of alternative text candidates found during extraction and kept for audit and debugging.

author.description: Object with the public identity of the post author, filled only with the fields Facebook exposed.

source_user_id.description: Facebook user ID of the post author as a string, or null when not exposed.

name.description: Public display name of the post author, or null when not exposed.

url.description: Public Facebook profile URL of the post author, or null when not exposed.

stats.description: Object with best-effort public engagement counters for the post: reactions, comments and shares.

reactions.description: Total number of public reactions on the post as an integer, or null when the count was not exposed.

comments.description: Number of comments on the post as an integer, or null when the count was not exposed.

shares.description: Number of shares of the post as an integer, or null when the count was not exposed.

media.description: Array of final recovered public photo objects attached to the post, after any media expansion.

source_media_id.description: Facebook identifier of the photo as a string, or null when Facebook did not expose one.

media_type.description: Type of media item, normally photo, or null when the type was not exposed.

source_url.description: Direct URL of the full-size public photo, or null when unavailable.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of a smaller public thumbnail for the photo, or null when unavailable.

width.description: Original photo width in pixels, or null when Facebook did not expose it.

height.description: Original photo height in pixels, or null when Facebook did not expose it.

source.description: Where the media URL was recovered from, such as graphql or html, or null when unknown.

index.description: Zero-based position of the photo in the post's recovered media order.

video_urls.description: Array of best-effort direct video URLs found for the post, empty when no video URLs were exposed.

media_set_tokens.description: Array of Facebook media-set tokens associated with the post, used to locate and expand its photo albums.

media_preview_count.description: Number of valid photo URLs exposed directly in the timeline payload before any expansion.

media_expanded_count.description: Number of valid photo URLs recovered through the additional media expansion step.

media_final_count.description: Final number of photo objects returned in the media array.

media_declared_count.description: Number of album attachments that Facebook declared for the post, or null when Facebook did not expose this count.

media_declared_count_satisfied.description: True when the final number of recovered photos meets Facebook's declared attachment count, false when it falls short, or null when no declared count was available.

media_completeness.description: Outcome label describing how media expansion went and whether the recovered photo set is considered complete.

media_completeness_legacy.description: Completeness label in the older legacy format, kept for backward compatibility, or null when not set.

media_review_severity.description: Media audit signal showing how much manual review the photo set needs: none means no concern, and low, medium and high mean increasing risk that photos are missing or incorrect.

media_plus_n_risk.description: True when Facebook likely hid more photos behind a +N overlay than were recovered, otherwise false.

media_counts.description: Object with a breakdown of media counts gathered during extraction, or null when not available.

media_source.description: Label for the source the final media set was taken from, or null when no media was recovered.

media_complete_confidence.description: Confidence label for how certain the scraper is that the recovered media set is complete, or null when not assessed.

media_expansion.description: Object with diagnostic details of the media expansion attempt for the post, or null when no expansion was run.

coverage_status.description: Reason why collection stopped for the profile this row belongs to.

warnings.description: Array of non-fatal warning messages produced while extracting this post, empty when there were none.

raw_payload_json.description: Parsed original source payload for the post, included only when includeRawPayload is enabled and otherwise null.

posts.title: Posts
posts.description: Public Facebook personal-profile posts with text, timestamps, stable URLs, engagement, and photo-completeness diagnostics.
